outline:
本課程使學生具有基礎韓語能力，並加強閱讀能力及TOPIK訓練。
The focus of this course is to enable students to have Korean abilities and to strengthen the training or drilling of reading comprehension of the Korean language and TOPIK test.
schedule:
1st-week 第一堂課 介紹教材內容 Introduction
2nd week 練習韓文單字發音(外來語), 韓文單字發音(漢字語) Pronunciation; consonant and vowel
3rd week 動詞一：基本動詞 Food
4th week 動詞二：由固有語組成 Related Grammar
5- week 形容詞：加組成的固有語題型分析, 純固有語 Related Grammar
6- week 副詞疑問詞 Related Grammar:adverbs
7- week weather forecast
8- week Mid-Test
9- week Make an appointment
10- week 閱讀練習題 Reading and Practicing
11- week Travel
12 week 閱讀練習題 Reading and Practicing
13-- week Transportation
14-week Writting and Speaking
15-week Writting
16- week Term 期末
17-18 online
